semantics.snapshot_id: Opaque bridge-generated UUID for one transfer attempt; no digest validation.
semantics.accepted: Passes shape AND context-specific token/nonce/session/source/scope/transfer authority. Shape-valid envelopes can still be ignored.
semantics.timeout: Heartbeat timeout accepts a fresh nonce immediately; old nonce/session cannot revive. Exhausted snapshot delivery attempts impose 10 seconds of Hello backoff.
semantics.application_ack: Only exact current session/revision/snapshot_id and completely sent transfer can advance applied_revision; chunk ack loss alone does not invalidate application acknowledgment.
semantics.heartbeat_ack: Only a current-session emitted current positive sequence, newer than the last acknowledged sequence, extends transport liveness.
semantics.nonce_replay: 4096 SHA256 digests retained for bridge service lifetime, without eviction. Used nonces cannot replace a newer session. Active-session same-nonce Hello remains idempotent. At capacity new nonces are ignored; explicit bridge restart clears connection-only history, while SQLite source binding/cache remain unchanged.
semantics.control_budget: Hello acceptance reserves required heartbeat overhead including populated UTC timestamps, numeric fields and at most 64 characters of error label. A shape-valid Hello can be ignored when this mandatory control budget cannot fit 1024 UTF-8 bytes. An individual session serialization failure invalidates that session without terminating delivery service.
